cases.fault: missing, corrupt, or wrong-format RunLedger/context packet
cases.legal_next_action: preserve files and diagnose exact run identity
prohibited: initialize a different run over the same identity

cases.fault: TaskCard, frozen base, branch, authority, state root, or compiled-contract identity drifts
cases.legal_next_action: create a separately authorized run or restore exact intent

cases.fault: compiled RunContract SHA is omitted or drifted at handler entry
cases.legal_next_action: preserve the run and diagnose the exact immutable contract binding
prohibited: drop the compiled-contract binding from the existing ledger

cases.fault: Agent Bus does not support the pinned structured handler-argv contract or argv normalization rejects an unsafe token/wrapper
cases.legal_next_action: install the compatible independently versioned Bus/runtime or correct the structured argv contract
prohibited: interpret business input through a shell

cases.fault: route missing, non-unique, or role override mismatched
cases.legal_next_action: correct owner route/configuration and create or redeliver only an exact authorized input

cases.fault: effective tool/model differs from integrity-bound delivery/TaskCard selection
cases.legal_next_action: repair exact configuration/selection mismatch
prohibited: execute one provider and report another

cases.fault: stage, attempt, rework budget, terminal, or current evidence commit is incompatible
cases.legal_next_action: status/diagnosis names the recorded denial; owner corrects intent if legal

cases.fault: follow-up review uses input attempt greater than one or exceeds the single review-stage slot unlocked by one authorized rework
cases.legal_next_action: preserve the recorded denial and require a separately authorized rework before another review slot
prohibited: raise the global per-delivery attempt limit

cases.fault: same delivery ID and same canonical payload is redelivered before provider start
cases.legal_next_action: use only exact durable checkpoint/outbox/inbox state

cases.fault: same delivery ID is reused with a different canonical payload
cases.legal_next_action: preserve conflict for owner diagnosis

cases.fault: crash after RunLedger authorization but before checkpoint/outbox/inbox creation
cases.legal_next_action: preserve the consumed authorization/budget and deny automatic provider replay
prohibited: assume the provider did not start
cases.reference_gap: Current duplicate path has no durable worker record from which to prove a safe automatic action.

cases.fault: crash after authorization/checkpoint model_not_started and before process start
cases.legal_next_action: invoke once after exact gates and checkpoint revalidation

cases.fault: crash after model_started is durable but no trusted completed result is recoverable
cases.legal_next_action: preserve exact process/workspace/evidence for owner decision

cases.fault: model_started has exact durable same-event zero-exit evidence and matching workspace manifest
cases.legal_next_action: promote to model_completed and resume validation without provider invocation

cases.fault: provider exits non-zero or trusted result evidence is corrupt/mismatched
cases.legal_next_action: record failure/ambiguity and preserve the same delivery evidence

cases.fault: crash after durable provider completion before postflight
cases.legal_next_action: skip provider and run frozen postflight against exact durable workspace

cases.fault: missing, multiple, malformed, oversized, unsafe, untracked, hash-drifted, or invalid Artifact
cases.legal_next_action: one bounded same-delivery artifact correction where explicitly supported, otherwise owner-authorized replacement

cases.fault: crash after postflight_completed before trusted import
cases.legal_next_action: revalidate exact workspace/contract and import the verified tree/report

cases.fault: crash after trusted import before commit
cases.legal_next_action: revalidate imported tree/workspace and create the trusted commit

cases.fault: trusted commit exists but push/fresh fetch fails or fork SHA differs
cases.legal_next_action: resume from exact commit after fresh remote verification succeeds

cases.fault: PR create/lookup is ambiguous, missing, multiple, or tuple/state/head repository drifts
cases.legal_next_action: re-read exact PR number and full tuple; resume only on equality

cases.fault: prior implement delivery is missing/non-unique or checkpoint/workspace/commit/PR/tree/Git manifest drifts
cases.legal_next_action: preserve the recorded lineage and obtain owner correction if possible

cases.fault: crash after trusted local/Git/PR effects before outgoing intent is durable
cases.legal_next_action: revalidate exact effects and prepare one deterministic outbox envelope

cases.fault: crash with immutable prepared outbox
cases.legal_next_action: verify current provenance and send the same delivery identity

cases.fault: send raises, returns failure, or process crashes while status is attempting
cases.legal_next_action: mark/retain ambiguous and resend only the identical idempotent envelope after evidence revalidation

cases.fault: crash after sent status before source inbox completion
cases.legal_next_action: do not resend; complete exact input inbox then return handler success

cases.fault: identical completed input is redelivered
cases.legal_next_action: revalidate required v2 provenance where applicable and return success without repeated effects

cases.fault: terminal report, Artifact, delivery, commit, or PR tuple drifts
cases.legal_next_action: preserve evidence and correct the external/current fact under explicit authority

cases.fault: crash after terminal ledger transition before terminal inbox completion
cases.legal_next_action: revalidate identical terminal evidence, complete exact inbox, and return success

cases.fault: a different terminal state or evidence is presented for a terminal run
cases.legal_next_action: preserve both facts for owner decision

cases.fault: handler fails before required local effect, outbox/inbox, or terminal is durable
cases.legal_next_action: allow transport redelivery; Workflow independently revalidates exact durable state

cases.fault: ACK observation is delayed or unavailable after handler success
cases.legal_next_action: retain local completion and observe Bus state without rewriting Workflow terminal

cases.fault: a retained, terminal, superseded, or identity-ambiguous historical delivery is proposed as new work or recovery input
cases.legal_next_action: leave the delivery and its evidence unchanged until exact owner abandonment/migration/recovery authority exists

cases.fault: install record/definition is missing, stale, unknown, or mismatched
cases.legal_next_action: name exact install or upgrade action from observed facts

cases.fault: profile/process/lease/launch/PID creation identity or live observation is missing/mismatched
cases.legal_next_action: preserve process/lease records and diagnose exact identity

cases.fault: legacy lease lacks launch/state-root binding but PID compatibility path is present
cases.legal_next_action: retain compatibility until replacement/retained-state audit proves safe disposition
prohibited: claim all retained identities have exact modern incarnation
cases.open_question: Phase 6 must close or explicitly retain the legacy exact-stop representation.

cases.fault: Feedback outbox is pending/corrupt/unavailable after a valid business terminal, or best-effort Finding queue persistence fails
cases.legal_next_action: report Feedback independently; retain the business terminal/ACK facts
prohibited: claim malformed reserved Finding envelope is a valid business Artifact

cases.fault: queue, GitHub, lifecycle, checkpoint, Feedback, or external observation is unavailable/stale/corrupt
cases.legal_next_action: report source/cause and one safe diagnostic action without mutation

cases.fault: candidate/old Runtime schema or envelope compatibility is unknown
cases.legal_next_action: preserve program and state evidence; use only a previously proven compatible program
